title: Executive Assistant
description:
Are you an experienced Executive Assistant or Personal Assistant who thrives in a busy, varied environment where no two days are the same?

We're looking for an Executive Assistant to support a senior Regional Director within a major national business, following a regional restructure and the creation of a new South West regional office in Exeter.

This is a high-profile role within a well-established and highly successful £1.7 billion distribution group, supporting a senior team and acting as a key point of contact for the region. You'll work with a wide range of people across the business, build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and external contacts, and play an important role in keeping the regional operation running smoothly.

You'll also have the benefit of a comprehensive handover and training from the current Executive Assistant, who is remaining within the business in another region.

Role Responsibilities

This is a broad and varied Executive Assistant position with significant responsibility. You'll be trusted to manage relationships, coordinate important meetings and events, handle confidential information and ensure senior stakeholders have the support they need.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Organising internal and external events, including travel, accommodation, entertainment and meals
- Organising staff meetings, preparing agendas, PowerPoint presentations and action logs
- Arranging meetings with suppliers and other business contacts
- Acting as a primary point of contact for the region, dealing with internal and external enquiries
- Building and maintaining relationships with senior contacts, suppliers, PAs and other key stakeholders
- Creating and maintaining spreadsheets to monitor a range of business data
- Providing proactive administrative support to a senior regional team

Requirements

To be successful in this role you should be an experienced Executive Assistant or PA, ideally someone who has worked within a larger business and is comfortable operating at senior level. You'll be someone who:
- Is confident building relationships with a wide range of people
- Has experience managing relationships and communications on behalf of a senior director or leadership team
- Is assertive, proactive and influential, with the confidence to get things done
- Is highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
- Can work independently and use initiative
- Has excellent attention to detail and strong time-management skills
- Has excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook
- Holds a full UK driving licence

Rewards
- Starting salary of £35,000 - £39,000
- Annual bonus
- Excellent pension scheme
- Full training and handover from an experienced Executive Assistant
- Working hours are Monday-Friday,

Apply today to find out more!

title: Planning Administrator
description:
Planning Administrator (Temporary)

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive team and make a real impact on service delivery.
Please APPLY today or contact Chelsea Goodman in the Pertemps Devon & Cornwall office.

title: Project Coordinator - Exeter
company: Build Maintain Recruit Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Join a Team That's Passionate About Property!
We're looking for an enthusiastic, organised and proactive Portfolio Property Coordinator to join an ambitious and friendly team in Exeter.
They don't just manage properties but are constantly looking for ways to improve, invest and create exceptional places for our tenants, guests and businesses. Their portfolio spans residential, commercial and holiday properties, making every day different and every challenge rewarding.
So, what's it all about?
This is a varied, hands-on position combining property management, facilities coordination and lease administration. You'll play a key role in keeping our portfolio running smoothly by coordinating maintenance, supporting tenants, managing contractors and ultimately, ensuring the properties remain safe, compliant and well maintained.
And better yet, you will be making a genuine impact!
What You'll Be Doing
- Coordinating planned and reactive maintenance
- Building positive relationships with tenants, contractors and suppliers.
- Managing property records, lease documentation and compliance requirements.
- Monitoring maintenance budgets and contractor performance.
- Supporting property acquisitions, disposals and improvement projects.
- Producing reports and identifying opportunities to improve processes and efficiency.
- Helping ensure the properties continue to provide an excellent experience for tenants and guests.

About You
I am looking to speaking to people are match up with the following:
- Naturally organised with excellent attention to detail.
- A confident communicator who enjoys building strong relationships.
- Proactive and resourceful, with a positive, can-do attitude.
- Comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a varied role.
- Keen to learn, develop and continuously improve.
- Confident using digital systems and happy working with data and documentation.
- Passionate about delivering outstanding customer service.

Previous property experience is beneficial, but just as important is your attitude, willingness to learn and ability to adapt. If you're someone who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen, you'll fit right in.
Why Join Us?
You'll become part of a collaborative, ambitious team that genuinely enjoys working together. No two days are the same, and you'll have the chance to work across a diverse property portfolio while developing your skills in a supportive environment.
What more could you want?!
If you're looking for a career where you can grow, be challenged and work alongside a passionate team that genuinely cares about what they do, then look no further!
Apply today and I can talk through this exciting position in much more detail!

title: Trainee Administrator
description:
If you are looking to work for a growing business who truly value and care for their employees, then look no further!
Aureos are seeking a Trainee Administrator to join our infrastructure team in Exeter. Working as part of a small team, you will provide administrative support and/or customer services, ensuring all tasks are fulfilled in accordance with quality standards and budget requirements.
Duties/Responsibilities
Promotion of Health and Safety policy
- Promote the Company's Health and Safety policy and ensure safe working practices are maintained at all times
- Act as a Coordinator to empower the leadership team on management of SHE returns (including monthly collation of depot and regional returns and uploading of information to SharePoint with finalised figures for Aureos).

General Administrative Procedures
- Working as part of a small team, coordinate and provide a full range of administrative support and/or customer services to ensure deadlines, quality standards and budget requirements are achieved.
- Assist in organising team and/or regional team meetings, arrange lunches, take notes and distribute minutes as required.
- Take personal ownership of accountability areas and problem solving and, where applicable, facilitate this within the team to ensure all issues are satisfactorily resolved at the lowest possible level.
- Working with Aureos systems, manage job raising, invoicing, asset management, these duties are not exhaustive.
- Perform other ad-hoc duties as required by Operations teams with guidance on areas of responsibility from Operations Managers, Regional Directors and Lead Admin.

Performance and Resourcing
- Working flexibly and as applicable, coordinate the operations team to ensure a high level of performance and best utilisation of resources in accordance with quality standards and budget requirements (i.e. Labour Programme coordination role); Manage fleet allocations to operational staff.

Document preparation
- Produce documents, briefing papers and presentations for Regional Directors, Operations Managers, Project Managers and Technicians as may be required; Prepare agendas and pre-meeting briefings.

Timesheet recording
- You will be responsible for inputting the information from the operational employees' details from their timesheets to our central online system.

Implementation tracking
- Attend project meetings as required, distribute post meeting actions to the team and track their completion.

Reporting and Correspondence
- Manage (State of Electricity Access Report) SEAR reporting and housekeeping of the system; Coordinate the collation of data and preparation of reports, schedules, summaries and correspondence as necessary (including organising of key reports e.g. weekly reports for Operations Managers/Regional Directors on Lead Indicators, Permits to Drive, outstanding debt, etc.).

Training and Development
- Coordinate the implementation of approved training plans (including one-to-one coaching as necessary) to ensure the provision of the required service in a resource efficient and cost-effective manner.

Storage of Information
- Maintain storage of company information in line with GDPR regulations.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to enhance admin service and reduce costs by continuous improvement of processes and practices.

Occupational Health Management
- Oversee booking and organisation of Occupational Health Checks, referrals, issues, work change requirements etc.

Fleet/vehicle management
- Manage fleet availability, allocation and reliability. Manage fleet allocations to operational staff, bookings for servicing/maintenance work and hire vehicles.

Knowledge, skills and experience
- Good literacy skills.
- Good communication skills (listens; welcomes feedback).
- Good time management and organisation skills.
- Ability to prioritise and coordinate tasks.
- Analytical and systematic approach to problem solving.
- Able to use own initiative.
- Contributes to effective team working.
- Able to work flexibly and contribute as part of a team.
- Attention to detail and accuracy.
- Commitment to continuous improvement.

In return you will receive
- Generous Salary
- 25 days Holiday with the option to buy more
- Pension
- Cycle to work scheme
- Free parking
- Health & wellbeing programme
- Employee benefits portal.
- On-site parking
- Private medical insurance
- Referral Scheme

Equal Opportunities
Aureos are an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.
Whether you are looking for progression in your new role or for your forever job, we will happily welcome your application.

title: Programme Administrator
company: Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic, creative and self-reliant individual to join our Project Management Office (PMO), providing high level administrative support to the PMO and South West Genomic Medicine Service Senior Leadership Team and supporting the smooth functioning of the Genomic Medicine Service in the South West Region The successful candidate will have exceptional communication skills, being able to engage with people of different experience and backgrounds, individually and in groups, both orally and in writing. You will support our Senior Leadership Team with a wide range of administrative functions including diary management, minute taking and managing sensitive information For more detail about the main duties of this role, please see the job description section below. As a key member of the Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust, you will be joining an exceptional team working together to help our patients to stay healthy, when they need it most. For more information on the Job Description and Responsibilities please click the link below. More detail about the role The South West Genomic Medicine Service (SWGMS) works with partners across healthcare providers to ensure the successful delivery of NHS Englands national genomic strategy. Bristol NHS Foundation Trust is the lead in this partnership with Royal Devon hosting and supporting a range of functions to support this activity for the whole region. We work in partnership to ensure equity of access to appropriate genomic testing for patients and their families in the NHS and to ensure the delivery of a patient centred, high-quality and innovation driven Genomic Medicine Service. The successful candidate will be required to work closely with the leadership teams across these organisations This role will require versatility and the ability to meet deadlines and manage change on a daily basis in order to meet the needs of this dynamic and fast-growing area of medicine. Support and training to provide an understanding of the service and service needs will be provided by the SWGMS Project Management Office team. This post will be based in Exeter at the Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust and can accommodate a combination of office and remote working if preferable. Whilst an Exeter based role, the post holder will be required to support team members within the Genomic Medicine Service who may be based at other sites and in other healthcare related organisations. As part of a regional organisation, the post holder will be required to travel to partner sites within the South West as required. Working Pattern: Monday to Friday Office Hours, 37.5 hours per week Interview Date: 18th September 2026 For further information please contact: Ana Gardiner-Juett Programme Manager ana.juett@nhs.net As an inclusive employer, the Royal Devon values diversity and is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where everyone can be themselves and reach their full potential. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities. We recognise the advantages of having a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. Preference will be given to staff with Priority and 'At Risk' status including NHS At Risk staff throughout Devon. The Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust reserves the right to close vacancy when sufficient applications have been received. The Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust was established in April 2022, bringing together the expertise of both the Royal Devon and Exeter NHS Foundation Trust and Northern Devon Healthcare NHS Trust. Benefits We will work together to maintain a culture that develops and supports you and your team. This might include funding for a care certificate, a degree or leadership qualifications. Or it might include days off to study, engage in CPD or rotational placements to help you hone your skills. Wherever you are heading in the NHS, we'll help you get there. Looking after you is important to us. We strive to help our staff create a healthy work-life balance through flexible working schemes and our family friendly policies. If you're starting out in the NHS, you'll start with 27 days paid annual leave (plus bank holidays), rising to 33 days plus bank holidays. You'll benefit from access to our own comprehensive occupational health services, including counselling, onsite wellbeing activities and groups. Salary is not the only financial benefit You'll have access to an extensive range of staff discounts on shopping, fitness and leisure options and you can spread the cost of technology and home appliance purchases from major retailers. You will also have access to other benefits including: National discount services such as the Blue Light Card and Health Service Discounts. Salary sacrifice options including our OFSTED rated outstanding nursery onsite at Exeter Car lease schemes. The NHS Pension scheme (one of the most generous and comprehensive in the UK). Cycle to work scheme These are just a few of the benefits available if the role is something you are interested in, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Patient Administrator
description: 30-35 hours per week, worked over 4 days on a set shift pattern within the practice opening hours of 8.00am to 6.30pm, Monday to Friday. We are seeking a motivated and adaptable administrator to join our busy and friendly team. The successful candidate will support the smooth running of our Practice covering a range of administrative and reception duties. You will have exceptional customer service skills and enjoy assisting our patients as well as liaising with other healthcare professionals. Your versatility and willingness to adapt to the changing needs of the surgery will be crucial along with the ability to work both independently and as a part of our multi-skilled team. Previous experience in a healthcare/ GP environment is preferred but with proven administration and organisation skills is not essential as in house training will be given to successful candidates. Receive, assist and direct patients and visitors in a courteous and positive manner, both in person and via the telephone. Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice. Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the Practice team, and other healthcare agencies. Receive, assist and direct patients and visitors in a courteous and positive manner, both in person and via the telephone. Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice. Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the Practice team, and other healthcare agencies. Key Responsibilities Communicate effectively with patients, staff, visitors and other agencies Receive, welcome and advise patients, sign posting them where necessary Make appointments and operate the appointments systems as directed Answer telephone enquiries from patients, staff and other external agencies Process and record information in accordance with Practice protocols Arrange patient referral appointments as directed by GPs utilising e-Referral system where appropriate. Liaise with the Referral Support Service as required Process and distribute incoming and outgoing mail Administer new patient registrations and patient deductions Explain Practice arrangements to newly registering patients Monitor the practice website for patient submissions and send appropriate responses Booking and monitoring of patient waiting lists Unlock/lock premises and maintain security in accordance with Practice protocols Attend Practice meetings and staff training as required Responsibilities will be reviewed periodically in line with changing circumstances. Duties and responsibilities may be varied as required by the Partners and Practice Manager, in consultation with the post holder, in order to maintain a high standard, efficient reception/ administration service. Generic Responsibilities All staff at Woodbury Surgery have a duty to conform to the following: Equality, Diversity & Inclusion A good attitude and positive action towards ED&I creates an environment where all individuals are able to achieve their full potential. Creating such an environment is important for three reasons: it improves operational effectiveness, it is morally the right thing to do, and it is required by law. Patients and their families have the right to be treated fairly and be routinely involved in decisions about their treatment and care. They can expect to be treated with dignity and respect and will not be discriminated against on any grounds including age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Patients have a responsibility to treat other patients and our staff with dignity and respect. Staff have the right to be treated fairly in recruitment and career progression. Staff can expect to work in an environment where diversity is valued and equality of opportunity is promoted. Staff will not be discriminated against on any grounds including age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Staff have a responsibility to ensure that you treat our patients and their colleagues with dignity and respect. Safety, Health, Environment and Fire (SHEF) This practice is committed to supporting and promoting opportunities for staff to maintain their health, well-being and safety. You have a duty to take reasonable care of health and safety at work for you, your team and others, and to cooperate with employers to ensure compliance with health and safety requirements. All personnel are to comply with the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974, Environmental Protection Act 1990, Environment Act 1995, Fire Precautions (workplace) Regulations 1999 and other statutory legislation. Confidentiality This practice is committed to maintaining an outstanding confidential service. Patients entrust and permit us to collect and retain sensitive information relating to their health and other matters, pertaining to their care. They do so in confidence and have a right to expect all staff will respect their privacy and maintain confidentiality at all times. It is essential that if, the legal requirements are to be met and the trust of our patients is to be retained that all staff protect patient information and provide a confidential service. Quality & Continuous Improvement (CI) To preserve and improve the quality of our output, all personnel are required to think not only of what they do, but how they achieve it. By continually re-examining our processes, we will be able to develop and improve the overall effectiveness of the way we work. The responsibility for this rests with everyone working within the practice to look for opportunities to improve quality and share good practice. This practice continually strives to improve work processes which deliver health care with improved results across all areas of our service provision. We promote a culture of continuous improvement, where everyone counts and staff are permitted to make suggestions and contributions to improve our service delivery and enhance patient care. Learning and Development The effective use of training and development is fundamental in ensuring that all staff are equipped with the appropriate skills, knowledge, attitude and competences to perform their role. All staff will be required to partake and complete mandatory training as directed by the training coordinator, as well as participating in the practice training programme. Staff will also be permitted (subject to approval) to undertake external training courses which will enhance their knowledge and skills, progress their career and ultimately, enable them to improve processes and service delivery.
